name: generate_meme
description: Generate a meme image based on a search prompt and captions. Can optionally send to Slack.

prompt.description: Keyword to find a meme template (e.g., 'doge', 'cat', 'coding').

topText.description: Text to appear at the top of the meme.

bottomText.description: Text to appear at the bottom of the meme.

sendToSlack.description: Whether to send the generated meme to the configured Slack channel.
